experimental_method: Rocking autoclave equilibrium at constant CO2 pressure; liquid sample withdrawn into a Monel tube, CO2 distilled out, absorbed in standard Ba(OH)2 and back-titrated.
uncertainties_stated: Temperature control +-0.06 C; pressure readable to +-0.25 psi below 500 psi and +-0.50 psi above; no uncertainty on solubility stated.
quality_remarks: Synthetic sea water (Subow/Brujewicz recipe) used since natural sea water varies. The 50 atm pure-water pressure was not investigated because of possible hydrate; authors note hydrate formation at higher pressure may explain literature disagreement. Rows at -5 C and some 0 C / 5 C / 38 atm may lie in the hydrate region but the paper does not say; regime left empty. Sea-water solvent is described only as 'solvent'. Text uses 'Atm.' for pressure.
